add_definitions(-D__SECURITY__)
spec2def(security.dll security.spec)

# security.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/security-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(security security-cargo security.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
